title: Rail Dash
core_verb: Dodge obstacles by switching between three lanes, jumping, or ducking while running forward automatically.
fantasy: A runner escapes through a railway corridor containing tracks, trains, barriers, and coins.
fail_state: Collide with a train or barrier; the collision immediately ends the run.
win_state: Cross the target-distance gate at the end of the fixed track segment without crashing.

interaction_tags.meaning: Oncoming train or fixed barrier; collision immediately ends the run.
Optional collectible placed along lanes and jump paths; contact adds one coin.
Goal gate at the end of the fixed segment; crossing it wins the run.

notes: The original endless runner is reduced to one fixed single-player track segment: the character runs forward automatically, dodges lane obstacles, optionally collects coins, and wins by reaching the segment's distance gate.

scene.description: A dimly lit underground railway corridor split into three lanes, with oncoming trains, barriers and coins along the way and a distance gate at the end. Concrete pillars and graffitied tunnel walls rush past under flickering fluorescent strips, signal lights and ventilation grates. Dense, so the player is maneuvering constantly.
